why: The selected check keyed on `.ui-selectable` instead of `.ui-selectable--on`: every choice in every row carries a check, which reads as all of them chosen -- the opposite of the signal issue #630 adds. Nothing in jsdom computes pseudo-element styles, so the guard reads the stylesheet text: every pseudo-element selector on a selectable must name the chosen modifier.
killedBy: hud.css: the selected check (issue #630) draws the check on the CHOSEN control only
